title: Services Agreement 2021-2022 - P&A Administrative Services, Inc. - Risk Management Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2021-2022 by and between the District and P&A Administrative Services, Inc., Buffalo, NY, for the latter to serve as Third Party Administrator of the District’s Flexible Spending Account (FSA), Dependent Care Assistance Program (DCPA), Transit, COBRA and Billing Services, as delineated in Exhibit A of Agreement, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, for the term March 1, 2022 through June 30, 2025, at a cost not to exceed $90,000.00 annually, not to exceed $270,000.00 cumulatively for the term.
headline: Pays P&A Administrative Services up to $270,000 to run employee benefit accounts through 2025
summary: The district is hiring P&A Administrative Services, Inc. of Buffalo, NY to administer its Flexible Spending Account, dependent care, transit, COBRA and billing services for employees. The cost can be no more than $90,000 per year and $270,000 over the whole term, March 1, 2022 through June 30, 2025.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
